description: Strength of a narrative (ai-agents, rwa, depin, modular, memes, bitcoin-l2, socialfi, gamefi): the mean BCA narrative strength score of its member entities over 7d, 30d or 90d, with each member's score. Recomputed every 4 hours; partial when some members have no score, unseeded when none does, stale when the scores are older than 8 hours. An unknown narrative is an error that lists the known ones. Starter tier.
name: track_narrative
